findings.title: Unsubscribe crashes when the user has no TopicUser row
findings.body: `TopicUser.find_by` can return nil, but the action immediately calls `tu.notification_level` and later `tu.save!`. A logged-in user hitting `/t/:slug/:id/unsubscribe` for a topic they have never visited, or whose TopicUser row has been removed, gets a NoMethodError/500 instead of an unsubscribe. Use `TopicUser.change` (which creates the row and publishes the level change) or handle nil explicitly.

findings.title: Unsubscribe is a state-changing GET with no signed token
findings.body: The new route is a plain GET that calls `TopicsController#unsubscribe`, which changes the logged-in user's `topic_users.notification_level`. Because the URL has no signed per-recipient token and GET requests are not CSRF-protected, any third-party page can embed/fetch this URL for a logged-in user and silently mute or downgrade notifications for a topic; mail scanners/link prefetchers can trigger the same effect. Use a signed token and/or a POST/confirmation flow for the mutation.

findings.title: Repeated unsubscribe requests progressively downgrade the topic
findings.body: The new level depends on the current level: watching/tracking becomes regular, while regular/muted becomes muted. A page refresh, double-click, or a fetched-link retry therefore runs the mutation again and can take a user from watching to regular and then to muted. The unsubscribe target should be deterministic/idempotent (or encoded in a signed link), otherwise retries silently over-mute the topic.

findings.title: unsubscribe_link now requires unsubscribe_url for every add_unsubscribe_link email
findings.body: The shared server locale string now interpolates `%{unsubscribe_url}`. `Email::MessageBuilder` still treats `unsubscribe_url` as optional and only checks `add_unsubscribe_link` when rendering `I18n.t('unsubscribe_link', template_args)`. Any caller using `add_unsubscribe_link: true` without the new option, or a non-topic/digest mailer that only supplies `user_preferences_url`, will raise `I18n::MissingInterpolationArgument` and fail to build the email. Default `unsubscribe_url` to the preferences URL, guard the interpolation, or keep the per-topic sentence in a separate conditional string.

findings.title: No coverage for the new unsubscribe endpoint or per-topic link
findings.body: The PR adds a destructive controller action and URL but the only spec change adds an unused `unsubscribe_url` to an existing email-builder test. There are no tests that the per-topic URL appears in the email body, that `TopicsController#unsubscribe` updates `notification_level` correctly (including when no TopicUser exists), or that repeated requests do not further downgrade the setting. Add request/controller specs so these behaviors are protected.
